description: FMLA leave calculator — Offline US Family and Medical Leave Act calculator. Give start= (first day of leave). Computes the entitlement in hours (12 workweeks, or 26 with type=caregiver), hours remaining after usedHours=, the last day of continuous leave and the return-to-work business day, or the end date of a reduced schedule (reduced= hours still worked per week). Lists federal holidays inside the leave and whether they count (29 CFR 825.200(h)), employee/employer notice deadlines and certification timing, and an eligibility check (12 months, 1,250 hours, 50 employees within 75 miles). Params: start, weeks, hoursPerWeek, usedHours, reduced, type, tenureMonths, hoursWorked, employees. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_fmla_leave
